basic_details.short_information: Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited (UPMRC), a joint venture of the Government of India and the Government of Uttar Pradesh, needs one Chief Controller of Stores (CCoS) on deputation basis for a normal tenure of 3 years, which may be extendable, on parent pay plus deputation allowance. The post is open to Officers / Executives of store department working in Government Organizations, Public Sector Undertakings and Government Metro Companies, with SAG / Selection Grade (CDA) or equivalent IDA pay scale and 17 years of post-qualification work experience. age_limit.details: The age limit is Max. 57 years . The cut-off date for age and eligibility criteria is the last date of notification of vacancy, that is 16 December 2026. The Matric Certificate is to be enclosed as proof of age.

qualification.details: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The application form asks for each qualification, subject, institution, percentage or CGPA and passing year, with supporting documents.

how_to_apply: Fill in the Prescribed Proforma for Submission of Application on Deputation Basis enclosed with the vacancy notice, without leaving the Vacancy Notice No., File No., post applied for and choice of station (wherever applicable) blank.

Give the details of service in CDA / IDA pay scales, previous deputation or foreign assignment, APAR ratings for the last 04 years, awards, and any conviction, penalty or pending case, as the form asks, and sign the declaration.

Submit the application through proper channel, requesting the parent organisation to forward it along with NOC, D&AR and Vigilance Clearance and APAR ratings for the preceding 04 years. The parent organisation completes the "Certificate by the Employer" in the form, with signature and stamp.

Send the application to: Manager (HR), Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited, Administrative Building, Near Ambedkar Samajik Parivatan Sthal, Vipin Khand, Gomti nagar, Lucknow-226010, before the closing date 16/12/2026.
An advance copy of the application, along with all supporting documents, may be sent to [email protected]; sending the hard copy of the application is mandatory.
Educational Certificates (including Matric Certificate for age eligibility)
Vigilance and D&AR Clearance from present Employer
Detailed note with supporting documents for the essential work experience and the pay-scale eligibility, and supporting documents for previous deputation, APAR ratings and awards
important_instructions: Applications received through proper channel and with verification of service particulars, SPE / D&AR / Vigilance clearance and enclosure of APARs will be preferred. Applications received after the closing date and time, and incomplete applications, shall not be entertained. UPMRC will not be responsible for any postal delay, wrong delivery or non-delivery of communication by the candidate at any stage. Applicants should keep their email address and mobile / phone number active so that UPMRC can reach them when required, and should check their e-mail (including spam) and the UPMRC website for updates. The final result will be informed in due course through the UPMRC website; interim enquiries about the result will not be attended to, and UPMRC does not correspond about reasons for non-selection. Management reserves the right to cancel / postpone the entire process for administrative reasons. Success in the screening process does not confer any right to appointment unless the Corporation is satisfied, after such enquiry as considered necessary, about the candidate's character and antecedents. The form asks whether the applicant is debarred from deputation, whether the cooling-off period is completed, whether applied under the Central Staffing Scheme, and whether the applicant appeared for an interview in UPMRC in the past. UPMRC office phone: 0522 - 2304014-15.

content_sections.heading: About UPMRC
content_sections.text: Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Ltd. (UPMRC) is a 50:50 jointly owned company of the Government of India and the Government of Uttar Pradesh, with its office at Administrative Building, Vipin Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow-226010. It implements and operates the rail-based Mass Rapid Transit System (Metro) in cities of Uttar Pradesh; Metro is operational in Lucknow, Kanpur and Agra (priority corridor), works on the balance corridors of the Kanpur and Agra Metro Projects are in progress, and an 11.2-kilometre East-West Metro Corridor under Phase 1B of the Lucknow Metro project has recently been approved.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is open only to Officers / Executives of store department working in Government Organizations, Public Sector Undertakings, Government Metro Companies and similar bodies, on deputation. A candidate must meet one of the pay-scale conditions below, along with the essential work experience. (i) Pay Scale of CDA: Executives/Officers either working or empanelled in SAG pay scale of Rs 1,44,200-2,18,200/- (Revised/Level-14)/Rs. 37,400-67,000/- + Grade Pay Rs. 10,000/- (Pre-revised) or higher with a total of 17 years of post-qualification work experience at Group-A Gazetted / Executive Level, including services put in on deputation. OR Executives/Officers either working or empanelled in Selection Grade pay scale of Rs. 1,23,100-2,15,900/- (Revised/Level-13)/ Rs. 37,400-67,000/- + Grade Pay Rs. 8,700/- (Pre-revised) or higher for at least 03 years, with a total of 17 years of post-qualification work experience at Group-A Gazetted / Executive Level, including services put in on deputation. (ii) Pay Scale of IDA: Executives/Officers either working or empanelled in IDA pay scale of Rs.1,20,000- 2,80,000 (Revised)/Rs.51300 - 73000/- (Pre-revised) or higher with a total of 17 years of post-qualification work experience at Group-A Gazetted/Executive Level, including services put in on deputation. OR Executives/Officers either working or empanelled in IDA pay scale of Rs. 90,000-2,40,000/-(Revised)/ Rs. 36,600-62,000/- (Pre- Revised) or higher for at least 03 years, with a total of 17 years of post-qualification work experience at Group-A Gazetted/ Executive Level, including services put in on deputation. The candidate should have varied experience of working in store department of Indian Railways/Govt. Metro/Railway PSUs/RRTS/Govt Organization/PSUs and should be conversant with functioning in computerized environment. The notice adds that experience should be with Indian Railways/Govt. Metro/Railway PSUs/RRTS/Govt Organizations/PSUs. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The application form asks for each qualification, subject, institution, percentage or CGPA and passing year, with supporting documents. The age limit is Max. 57 years . The cut-off date for age and eligibility criteria is the last date of notification of vacancy, that is 16 December 2026. The Matric Certificate is to be enclosed as proof of age. The candidate should be free from D&AR / Vigilance. The applicant should be fit in the related field and should also be physically and medically fit. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The scale of pay is parent pay plus deputation allowance on deputation basis; the notice prints no separate pay scale for the post. The appointment is on deputation, with a normal tenure of 3 years, which may be extendable. The selected officer may be posted at any of the project sites / offices at any location of UPMRC projects during the tenure in UPMRC. All appointees are deemed to be public servants for the purpose of the UPMRC's Conduct, Discipline and Appeal Rules, 2017 and such other statutes as notified by the government from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates would be called for interview at Lucknow, and selection is on interview basis. The Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited reserves the right to shortlist candidates for interview. Submission of the NOC before the interview is a must for participating in the interview process. Candidates called for interview will not be paid any travelling allowance by UPMRC.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in UPMRC Chief Controller of Stores Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Chief Controller of Stores (CCoS), to be filled on deputation basis under Vacancy Notice No. UPMRC/HR/D/3/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The closing date is 16 December 2026, which is 30 days from the date of notification of vacancy; applications received after the closing date and time are not entertained.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the UPMRC Chief Controller of Stores post?
faq.answer: Officers / Executives working or empanelled in SAG or Selection Grade (CDA) or the stated IDA pay scales, with 17 years of post-qualification work experience at Group-A Gazetted / Executive Level and varied experience in store departments of Indian Railways, Govt. Metro, Railway PSUs, RRTS, Govt organisations or PSUs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is Max. 57 years, reckoned as on the last date of notification of vacancy, 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for UPMRC Chief Controller of Stores?
faq.answer: The post carries parent pay plus deputation allowance on deputation basis.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the UPMRC Chief Controller of Stores post?
faq.answer: Submit the prescribed application form through proper channel, forwarded by the parent organisation with NOC, D&AR and Vigilance Clearance and APARs for 04 years, to Manager (HR), UPMRC, Administrative Building, Near Ambedkar Samajik Parivatan Sthal, Vipin Khand, Gomti nagar, Lucknow-226010, before 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is on interview basis, and eligible candidates would be called for interview at Lucknow; UPMRC reserves the right to shortlist candidates for interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is on deputation, with a normal tenure of 3 years, which may be extendable.

faq.question: Q9. Can I send the application by email?
faq.answer: An advance copy with all supporting documents may be sent to [email protected], but sending the hard copy of the application is mandatory.

faq.question: Q10. Is travelling allowance paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, candidates called for interview shall not be paid any travelling allowance by UPMRC; the NOC must be submitted before the interview to take part.
